# SmoothUI Orb source

Retrieved 2026-09-22 from https://smoothui.dev/r/orb.json and
https://github.com/educlopez/smoothui/blob/main/apps/docs/examples/orb.tsx.
Copyright (c) 2024 Eduardo Calvo. MIT; see SMOOTHUI-LICENSE.txt.

The preview uses the Bloom palette (#f25aed, #ffffff), upstream defaults and
280px canvas. The stationary specular highlight is removed by request.
No extra white wave mask, brightness lift or Gaussian colour field is used.
Soundi retains six-colour support, optional contour controls, opacity control
and the vanilla WebGL lifecycle adapter. Bloom sets contour deformation to zero
and opacity to one; these extensions do not alter the default Bloom material.
The composition screen continues to receive music-derived colours and motion.
